answer: One chip, one identity: a fresh attestation quote is required every 18 epochs and a chip caught signing for two keys burns both seats. Building 286 fake identities means buying 286 chips, each worth more than the epoch payout, while an honest agent uses the device it already has. What carries the sonnet here is verification, the nebula of cost is what stops the farm, and the mesa of the record keeps every claim checkable.
